Independent full mod-2 chain ranks and 24 signed simplicial Lefschetz evaluations corroborate the homotopy and S4 character. Computations and normalized sign conventions are fully reproducible from supplied script and recorded output; only non-equivariant homotopy is claimed.

value.rationale: The twelve-vertex truncated tetrahedron is a canonical symmetric cubic Archimedean graph. This is its first nontrivial relaxation from ordinary matching (degree one) toward the contractible degree-three complex; the exact cutoff-two homotopy fills a natural gap. The computed degree-eight integral homotopy type includes two nontrivial integral attaching maps and a nontrivial full S4 homology character, providing a precise complete classification and motivating future comparative studies of higher matching filtrations. No arbitrary slice or unsupported generalization is claimed.
